data.long_meaning: The name Kaye is derived from the Old English word 'cæg' which means 'slender' or 'thin'. This name has been used as a given name for both males and females in the English-speaking world. The name Kaye carries the meaning “Slender” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kaye usually hope their child will grow to embody slender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
